practice.title: Practice karein
practice.subtitle: History bhari hui ek real repo aapke tab me hi hai. Files edit karein, stage, commit, branch, stash aur merge karein — even ek real conflict ke <<<<<<< markers manually resolve karein.
practice.openDesc: Ek ready repo history ke saath yahin chalta hai — stage, commit, branch, stash, diff, aur ek real merge conflict banakar resolve bhi karein. Kuch install nahi hota, kuch aapki machine se bahar nahi jaata.
practice.footnote: Sab kuch aapke device par ek sandbox me chalta hai — kuch upload nahi hota. Reset aapka session mita deta hai; tab band karne par sab discard ho jaata hai.
practice.unlinkedHint: Tip: kisi bhi command page (git status, git merge, git rebase, …) se “Open practice playground” dabayein — usi command ki practice yahan guided hints ke saath khol jayegi.
practice.booting: Practice sandbox shuru ho raha hai…
practice.resetConfirm: Practice shuru se karein? Aapki progress khatam ho jayegi.

footer.tagline: Git ko andar se samjhein. Sirf commands nahi, pura model.
footer.madeFor: Jo insaan Git ko sach me samajhna chahta hai.

tip.body: Tip: animated diagrams aur code bade screen par sabse clearly dikhte hain — phone ko sideways karein ya desktop par kholen, poori experience milegi.

lang.label: Language
lang.hinglishNote: Hindi mix — Indian readers ke liye

home.badge: Git ko aise seekhein jaise woh sach me kaam karta hai
home.subtitle: Bas yaad karne ko nahi. Har command ka simple explain, objects/refs aur HEAD ke andar kya hota hai uska animated view — aur wo real aliases jo pros roz type karte hain.
home.mentalTitle: Chaar cheezein. Poore engine ka raaz.
home.mentalSubtitle: Git ki har harkat objects, refs, index aur HEAD ke beech ka khel hai. Ye chaar samajh lo, neeche ki har command aasaan lagne lagegi.

fundamentals.title: Objects
fundamentals.desc: Har blob, tree, commit aur tag ek immutable, content-addressed object hai jo .git/objects me stored hai. Kabhi edit nahi hota — history sirf badhti hai.

fundamentals.title: Refs
fundamentals.desc: Ref ek file hai jisme ek commit ka hash hota hai — history me ek position ka naam. Branches aur tags same cheez, bas move hone ke rules alag.
points: har commit par branch move hoti hai

fundamentals.title: The Index
fundamentals.desc: Staging area bhi kehte hain. .git/index me aapka agla commit hota hai: path → blob-hash pairs. Snapshot lene se pehle usse bana sakte ho.
points: preview ki tarah kaam karta hai
status isi se compare karta hai

fundamentals.title: HEAD
fundamentals.desc: Ek file jo batati hai ki aap kis branch par ho. Jab commit, reset ya switch karte ho, HEAD (aur jo branch usse point karti hai) wahi move hota hai.

home.mapBannerTitle: Command map me ye sab kaise judta hai dekho
home.mapBannerDesc: Har command ko uski jagah par dikhaya hai — working tree, index, repository aur remote.
home.libraryTitle: Har command, uske kaam ke hisaab se.
home.ctaTitleStart: Guess karna band karo. Commits ko
home.ctaSubtitle: Koi ek command page kholo aur dekho uske objects, refs aur pointers aapki aankhon ke saamne move ho rahe hain — phir alias se hamesha ke liye yaad karo.
home.scenarioTitle: Saaf-suthra, insaan wala git ka din dekho
home.scenarioDesc: Solah guided steps: repo kharada karo, gandhi session ko chore / feat / style prefixes ke saath atomic commits me baanto, aur feature ko branch par ship karo — 50/72 rule se, na ki 50 files ek commit me.

undoing.label: Undoing & Rewriting
undoing.blurb: Commits aur galtiyon ko theek karein.

sharing.label: Sharing & Sync
sharing.blurb: Machines ke beech history move karein.

command.mapCta: Command map me ye kahaan fit hota hai
command.watchDesc: Ek narrated, step-by-step walkthrough jo dikhata hai kaise karna hai — sirf theory nahi. Ye us learner mode ke hisaab se adjust hota hai jo aapne upar select kiya.
command.aliasIntro: {cmd} ka concept yaad rakho, phir in shortcuts me se koi ek instant bana do. Aliases asli git config keys hain — aise banate hain:

map.title: Ek badlaav ka safar follow karein.
map.subtitle: Har command wahin rehta hai jahan woh kaam karta hai. File working tree me paida hoti hai, index me copy hoti hai, commit me seal hoti hai, phir remote tak jaati hai. Kisi bhi command par tap karke under the hood dekho.

legendStaged.title: Staged
legendStaged.desc: Index me copy ho gaya — agle commit ka content.

legendModified.title: Modified
legendModified.desc: Index se alag hai, abhi staged nahi.

legendUntracked.title: Untracked
legendUntracked.desc: Git ne kabhi na dekha — nayi ya ignore-worthy file.

player.noVisual: Iske liye koi diagram nahi hai — ye ek golden rule hai jo agle step se pehle yaad rakhna chahiye.

notFound.badge: HEAD yahaan detach ho jaata hai
notFound.title: Ye commit exist nahi karta.
notFound.body: Koi bhatki hui ref, force-push, ya typo — kuch yahaan point karke rewound ho gaya. Zindagi ke reflog me is page ka koi record nahi.

scenario.title: Ek asli git ka din. Insaan jaisa.
scenario.subtitle: Realistic session ka work/play walkthrough — chhote atomic commits, conventional prefixes, aur ek saaf kahani. Koi 50-file blob nahi, koi aalsi "update" message nahi.
scenario.ruleBody: Subject 50 characters se chhota, detail 72 par wrap. Agar ek change ko ek se zyada paragraph chahiye, toh uski apni commit banti hai.
scenario.whyBody: Atomic commit matlab ek logical change — review aasaan, revert aasaan, cherry-pick aasaan. 50-file mega-commit ek black box hai jise chhedne ki himmat kisi me nahi.
